sparql_query:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX kwgl-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/lite-ontology/>
PREFIX kwglr: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/lite-resource/>

SELECT DISTINCT
  ?place
  ?hazardType
  ?damageProp
  ?damageValue
  ?startDate
  ?endDate
WHERE {
  ?hazard a kwgl-ont:HazardEvent ;
          kwgl-ont:hasHazardType ?hazardType ;
          kwgl-ont:hasImpacted ?place .
  
  FILTER(?hazardType IN (kwglr:hurricane,
                         kwglr:tropicalStorm,
                         kwglr:tropicalDepression,
                         kwglr:stormSurgeTide))
  
  OPTIONAL { ?hazard kwgl-ont:hasStartDate ?startDate . }
  OPTIONAL { ?hazard kwgl-ont:hasEndDate   ?endDate   . }
  
  ?place ?damageProp ?damageValue .
  FILTER( regex(str(?damageProp),
                "dollarDamageOf.*(Hurricanes|StormSurges)",
                "i") )
}
ORDER BY ?place ?hazardType

PREFIX kwg-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/ontology/>
PREFIX sosa: <http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?hazardEvent ?impactProperty ?value
WHERE {
  # Impact observations linked to hazard events
  ?obs a kwg-ont:ImpactObservation ;
       sosa:hasFeatureOfInterest ?hazardEvent ;
       sosa:observedProperty   ?impactProperty ;
       sosa:hasSimpleResult    ?value .

  # Ensure the feature of interest is a hazard event (NOAA or any subclass)
  ?hazardEvent a ?hzClass .
  FILTER ( ?hzClass = kwg-ont:NOAAHazardEvent || ?hzClass rdfs:subClassOf* kwg-ont:Hazard )

  # The observed property must be an impact observable property (or its subclass)
  ?impactProperty rdfs:subClassOf* kwg-ont:ImpactObservableProperty .
}
ORDER BY ?hazardEvent ?impactProperty

sparql_query:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX kwg-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/ontology/>
PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
PREFIX sosa: <http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?hazard ?place ?time ?damageProp ?value
WHERE {
  # storm‑specific hazards (NOAA hazard events)
  ?hazard a kwg-ont:NOAAHazardEvent .
  
  # spatial relation to a geographic place
  ?hazard kwg-ont:spatialRelation ?place .
  ?place a geo:Feature .

  # temporal scope of the hazard
  ?hazard kwg-ont:hasTemporalScope ?time .

  # impact observations linked to the hazard
  ?obs a kwg-ont:ImpactObservation ;
       sosa:hasFeatureOfInterest ?hazard ;
       sosa:observedProperty ?damageProp .
       
  # ensure the observed property is a damage‑related observable
  ?damageProp rdfs:subClassOf* kwg-ont:ImpactObservableProperty .

  OPTIONAL { ?obs sosa:hasSimpleResult ?value . }
}
ORDER BY ?hazard ?time ?damageProp

sparql_query:
PREFIX kwg-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/ontology/>
PREFIX sosa: <http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?hazard ?damageProp ?result ?place ?time
WHERE {
  # impact observations that record damage details
  ?obs a kwg-ont:ImpactObservation ;
       sosa:observedProperty ?damageProp ;
       sosa:hasFeatureOfInterest ?hazard .
  OPTIONAL { ?obs sosa:hasResult   ?result . }
  OPTIONAL { ?obs sosa:phenomenonTime ?time . }

  # storm‑specific hazards (e.g., hurricane, tornado, flash flood, high wind, winter storm)
  ?hazard a ?hzClass .
  FILTER( ?hzClass IN (
            kwg-ont:NOAAHurricane,
            kwg-ont:NOAATornado,
            kwg-ont:NOAAFlashFlood,
            kwg-ont:NOAAHighWind,
            kwg-ont:NOAAWinterStorm) )

  # link the hazard to a geographical place
  { ?hazard kwg-ont:sfWithin      ?place . }
  UNION
  { ?hazard kwg-ont:spatialRelation ?place . }

  # the place must be some kind of region (administrative region, S2 cell, etc.)
  ?place rdf:type/rdfs:subClassOf* kwg-ont:Region .
}

What are all the damage details available done by tornado-specific hazards that are related to a geographical place within a certain temporal extent?

sparql_query:
PREFIX kwg-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/ontology/>
PREFIX sosa: <http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/>
PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
PREFIX time: <http://www.w3.org/2006/time#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?hazard ?damageProp ?value ?time
WHERE {
  # impact observations that describe damage caused by a hazard
  ?obs a kwg-ont:ImpactObservation ;
       sosa:hasFeatureOfInterest ?hazard ;
       sosa:observedProperty ?damageProp ;
       sosa:result          ?res .

  # restrict to damage‑related observable properties
  FILTER ( ?damageProp IN (
            kwg-ont:impactObservableProperty.damageCrop ,
            kwg-ont:impactObservableProperty.damageProperty ,
            kwg-ont:impactObservableProperty.deathDirect ,
            kwg-ont:impactObservableProperty.deathIndirect ,
            kwg-ont:impactObservableProperty.injuryDirect ,
            kwg-ont:impactObservableProperty.injuryIndirect
          ) )

  # extract the literal value from the result node (any predicate that yields a literal)
  ?res ?valuePred ?value .
  FILTER ( isLiteral(?value) )

  # temporal extent of the hazard (if recorded)
  OPTIONAL { ?hazard kwg-ont:hasTemporalScope ?time . }

  # link the storm‑specific hazard to a geographic place
  ?hazard (kwg-ont:sfWithin|kwg-ont:spatialRelation) ?place .
  ?place a geo:Feature .
}
ORDER BY ?hazard

sparql_query:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX kwgl-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/lite-ontology/>
PREFIX kwglr: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/lite-resource/>

SELECT DISTINCT 
       ?hazardEvent 
       ?hazardType 
       ?place 
       ?startDate 
       ?endDate 
       ?damageInfrastructure 
       ?damageCrops
WHERE {
  # hazard events that are storm‑related
  ?hazardEvent a kwgl-ont:HazardEvent ;
               kwgl-ont:hasHazardType ?hazardType .
  FILTER ( regex(str(?hazardType), "(hurricane|tornado|stormSurgeTide|flood|flashFlood|coastalFlood|highWind|strongWind)", "i") )
  
  # place impacted by the hazard
  ?place a kwgl-ont:Place ;
         kwgl-ont:impactedBy ?hazardEvent .
  
  # temporal information (optional – can be filtered externally)
  OPTIONAL { ?hazardEvent kwgl-ont:hasStartDate ?startDate . }
  OPTIONAL { ?hazardEvent kwgl-ont:hasEndDate   ?endDate   . }

  # damage details provided by the hazard event
  OPTIONAL { ?hazardEvent kwgl-ont:damageToInfrastructureInDollars ?damageInfrastructure . }
  OPTIONAL { ?hazardEvent kwgl-ont:damageToCropsInDollars           ?damageCrops . }
}

PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX kwgl-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/lite-ontology/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?entity ?damageProperty ?value
WHERE {
  # Damage details recorded on places impacted by a hazard
  ?hazard a kwgl-ont:HazardEvent ;
          kwgl-ont:hasImpacted ?place .
  ?place ?damageProperty ?value .
  FILTER(?damageProperty IN (
    kwgl-ont:dollarDamageOfFiresImpactingPlace,
    kwgl-ont:dollarDamageOfFloodsImpactingPlace,
    kwgl-ont:dollarDamageOfHurricanesImpactingPlace,
    kwgl-ont:dollarDamageOfLandslidesImpactingPlace,
    kwgl-ont:dollarDamageOfStormSurgesImpactingPlace,
    kwgl-ont:dollarDamageOfTornadoesImpactingPlace
  ))
  BIND(?place AS ?entity)

  UNION

  # Damage details recorded directly on hazard events
  ?hazard a kwgl-ont:HazardEvent .
  {
    ?hazard kwgl-ont:damageToCropsInDollars ?value .
    BIND(kwgl-ont:damageToCropsInDollars AS ?damageProperty)
    BIND(?hazard AS ?entity)
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?hazard kwgl-ont:damageToInfrastructureInDollars ?value .
    BIND(kwgl-ont:damageToInfrastructureInDollars AS ?damageProperty)
    BIND(?hazard AS ?entity)
  }
}
